title: Apple Pie in a Jar
description: This recipe allows you to gift an apple pie in a jar with this sweet, spicy apple pie filling processed it a water bath — all they'll need is a crust.
ingredients: 7 quarts peeled, cored and sliced apples

steps.text: Inspect seven 1-quart jars for cracks and rings for rust, discarding any defective ones. Immerse in simmering water until filling is ready. Wash new, unused lids and rings in warm soapy water.

Meanwhile, combine 10 cups water, sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg in a large pot over high heat; cook, stirring frequently, until thick and bubbly, 10 to 15 minutes. Off heat, stir in lemon juice.

Tightly pack apple slices into hot, sterilized jars, slowly pour sugar syrup over apples, covering them completely and filling to within ¼ inch of tops. Run a clean knife or thin spatula around insides of jars and gently tap each jar on the countertop to remove any air bubbles. Wipe rims with a moist paper towel to remove any residue. Top with lids and screw rings on tightly.

Place a rack in the bottom of a large stockpot and fill halfway with water. Bring to a boil and lower jars 2 inches apart into boiling water using a holder. Pour in more boiling water to cover jars by 2 inches. Bring to a rolling boil, cover, and process for 30 minutes.

Remove jars from the stockpot; set aside to rest, several inches apart, for 12 to 24 hours. Press centers of lids with a finger to ensure lids do not move up or down. Remove rings for storage and store in a cool, dark area.
